name: Checkgrow Website
description: The public Checkgrow marketing and waitlist website served at checkgrow.com.

backend: Next.js route handler for waitlist intake
stack.deployTarget: Easy Panel Docker service for checkgrow.com

repository.releaseFlow: push the complete approved working tree directly to main; main triggers the Easy Panel production deployment

supabase.notes: This website repository has no Supabase schema, migrations or edge functions. The waitlist route forwards to an existing external Checkgrow webhook configured through WAITLIST_WEBHOOK_URL.

deploy.invariant: After the complete manifest is approved, git add -A ships the entire local website working tree directly to main. No local website change is intentionally left behind.

cascades: A push to main triggers the Easy Panel production deployment for checkgrow.com.
Changes to the waitlist route must preserve explicit webhook failure handling and require WAITLIST_WEBHOOK_URL in production.
Brand identity changes remain bound to the Checkgrow Brand Pack and the site Decisions Log.

knownGaps.tooling: Docker is not installed locally. Easy Panel builds the committed Dockerfile remotely. The configured origin uses authenticated HTTPS; the equivalent SSH URL is recorded for repository identity.
knownGaps.backend: There is no deployable Supabase backend in this repository, so Supabase preflight and deployment steps are not applicable.
